items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was there anybody else in the band? ... Albert Francis was on drums. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah. Albert Francis was on drums.

ctx.x: Was there anybody else in the band? I can't see. I guess that's about every, was there a bass or drums? Albert Francis was on drums. Oh, there's a drum there. Yeah, Albert Francis. Albert Francis was the drummer.
Yeah, yeah. Albert Francis was on drums.

Yeah. But we certainly appreciated your loaning those pictures. I'm sorry it took so long to get it back. Oh, I mean, nothing. That was all right. We had somebody up at Tulane made a new negative. A little drum. A little drum. Because I had another one like that. If you ever need another copy, we can always get a new copy made, too.
